trap.label: ordem da inversão
trap.wrong: Were not it for the receipt, I could not prove it.
trap.right: Were it not for the receipt, I could not prove it.
trap.why: Em português “não fosse o recibo” coloca o não antes do sujeito. Em inglês, na inversão com Were, o sujeito vem logo depois e not depois dele.

mcq.q: Which is the formal version of “If you had kept it, …”?
“___ it not for the receipt, the claim would fail.”
Mixed: “Had I kept it, we ___ done now.”

fix.wrong: Had you would kept the receipt, we would be done.
fix.right: Had you kept the receipt, we would be done.

fix.wrong: Should you will need proof, call us.
fix.right: Should you need proof, call us.

fix.wrong: Were it for not the claim, we would stop.
fix.right: Were it not for the claim, we would stop.
